# KEA Building Contracting

> KEA Building Contracting is a construction company in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It builds luxury villas, private mansions, waterfront residences, residential buildings and commercial buildings, with in-house engineering, project management, planning, QA/QC and HSE.

## Company facts
- Name: KEA Building Contracting
- Type: Building contracting / construction company
- Location: Office 802, Iris Bay Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Phone: +971 4 326 1339
- Email: info@construct.ae
- Chief Executive Officer: Mohamad Fariz Harmouch
- Area served: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Communities: Palm Jumeirah, MBR City, DAMAC Lagoons, Dubai South, Gutti developments
- Developer landscape: DAMAC, Gutti, Zoya, Harko

## Construction services
- Luxury villa construction
- Mansion construction
- Waterfront and sea-view home construction
- Residential building construction
- Commercial building construction (corporate, industrial and community buildings)

## How KEA delivers
Engineering, project management, planning and controls, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and health, safety and environment (HSE) are brought together under one accountable team, from the first structural decision to final handover.
